mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market improvement, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong supply chain activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1150.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 380000), a decline in retail sales signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 1000 million dollars in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 380000 and RSAFS declines > 1000 million dollars.
